speaker: judith_sadler
text: There is no second pie. I said so. The dish is of the same mind.

speaker: hamnet_sadler
text: I am at the end of my dinner. The oven can have me back when you have the lane.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: We are near the end of it. I am not opening a thing that has already been shut.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Finish, then. The lane is the next room, and it is not this one.
